style2fab.title: Style2Fab
style2fab.description: Style2Fab: Functionality-Aware Segmentation for Fabricating Personalized 3D Models with Generative AI. A system called Style2Fab that allows users to selectively stylize 3D models without compromising their functionality.

instructMesh.title: InstructMesh
instructMesh.description: By operating directly on the intermediate latent representation, InstructMesh allows users to apply robust geometric corrections without requiring expert modeling skills.
